title: T'Shara
summary: Defeat T`Shara's aspects to remove her linked offensive and defensive benefits.
overview: Defeat T`Shara's aspects to remove her linked offensive and defensive benefits.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prioritize the protection aspect and coordinate damage during the time its benefit is absent.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The five aspects govern armor, combat, magic, power and protection; engaging the group links their aggression.
Defeating an aspect removes its corresponding benefit but starts a 150-second respawn window.
The aspects strengthen after thirty seconds of combat.
If every aspect is dead at once, the protection aspect is immediately replaced, so plan the kill sequence deliberately.

notes: Approval E357. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
